provenance.source: Logitech protocol Microsoft 30 Bit (id 85), cross-checked against its derived IRP and the Linux RC6-MCE encoder/decoder; the explicit 2664 us suffix is required to terminate a raw frame
provenance.hardware_validation: 2026-08-30: corrected toggle-0 and toggle-1 frames rendered through Harmony PK SsIr both controlled a real Windows Media Center receiver when alternated; a fully padded toggle-0 frame also worked on every press when alternated with toggle 1, isolating earlier intermittency as receiver debounce
